list.name: BPF detached
list.textFormat: The pinned BPF maps were unreadable on the last scrape; metric graphs go stale until the program is re-attached.

description: Grafana dashboard for the a2scache /metrics endpoint: eBPF A2S query verdicts, cache freshness and backend refresh health.

panels.title: BPF attached daemons
panels.description: Daemons with readable BPF pins out of all reporting daemons.

panels.title: Cached instances
panels.description: Total cached instances versus total compile-time capacity across all daemons.

panels.title: Cache utilization
panels.description: Fleet-wide percentage of CACHE_MAP slots in use.

panels.title: Backends healthy
panels.description: Backends whose last refresh succeeded out of all configured backends.

panels.title: Min daemon uptime
panels.description: Lowest uptime across selected daemons; drops when any daemon restarts.

panels.title: Daemons reporting
panels.description: Number of a2scache daemons currently scraped.

panels.title: BPF detached
panels.description: Daemons whose BPF maps were unreadable on the last scrape.

panels.title: Daemon versions
panels.description: One row per reporting daemon.

panels.title: Daemon fleet status
panels.description: One row per daemon: attachment, cache usage, uptime and backend health. Scales to any number of servers.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (instance) (a2scache_cache_entries{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "cache_entries", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(max by (instance) (a2scache_cache_capacity{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "capacity", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(round(100 * sum by (instance) (a2scache_cache_entries{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (a2scache_cache_capacity{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})), "col", "utilization_pct", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(min by (instance) (a2scache_bpf_attached{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "bpf_attached", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(min by (instance) (a2scache_daemon_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "uptime_s", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (instance) (a2scache_backend_up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "backends_up", "instance", ".*") or label_replace(max by (instance) (a2scache_daemon_backends{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "backends_total", "instance", ".*")

panels.title: Query verdicts over time
panels.description: Cache hits, pass-through and synthesized challenges per second. A healthy cache shows served_* dominating pass_through.

panels.title: Cache hit rate (5m)
panels.description: Served INFO/PLAYER responses as a percentage of all cacheable queries (served_* + pass_through).

panels.title: Verdict totals (24h)
panels.description: Total verdict counts over the last 24 hours, by `stat`. Use increase() so re-attach counter resets are handled.

panels.title: Drops by reason
panels.description: All `dropped_*` verdicts per second: rate limits, stale entries, bad challenges, oversized packets and rewrite failures.

panels.title: Rewrite failure breakdown
panels.description: The five low-level rewrite failure guards (guard, tail, hdr, payload, redirect) plus the aggregate dropped_rewrite.

panels.title: Total drop rate
panels.description: Sum of all `dropped_*` verdicts per second.

panels.title: Entry age vs TTL
panels.description: INFO/PLAYER age per cached instance against its effective TTL. Age approaching TTL means refresh is falling behind.

panels.title: Stale entries
panels.description: Entries whose INFO age exceeded a nonzero per-entry TTL (mirrors the README A2SCacheEntryStale alert).

panels.title: Per-instance cache detail
panels.description: One row per cached {ip,port}: payload ages, TTL and cached payload sizes.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_info_age_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "info_age", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_ttl_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "ttl", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_info_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "info_bytes", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_player_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "player_bytes", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_player_age_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "player_age", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_entry_challenge_age_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "challenge_age", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port")

panels.title: Backend status
panels.description: Per backend: last-refresh result, seconds since the last successful refresh, and the last refresh wall time.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_backend_up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "up", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) ((time() - a2scache_backend_last_success_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) and a2scache_backend_last_success_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} > 0), "col", "since_success", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port") or label_join(label_replace(sum by (instance,ip,port) (a2scache_backend_last_refresh_latency_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "col", "latency", "ip", ".*"), "key", " | ", "instance", "ip", "port")

panels.title: Backends down
panels.description: Backends whose last refresh failed. Alert threshold: greater than zero for two minutes (A2SCacheBackendDown).

panels.title: Refresh cycles per second
panels.description: Daemon refresh attempts per backend split by result; failures here are distinct from client-facing BPF drops.

panels.title: Refresh latency
panels.description: Wall time of the last completed refresh cycle (success or failure) per backend.

title: a2scache — eBPF A2S Query Cache
